newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU leaders break for lunch without EMU pact accord.
newsitem.headline: EU leaders break for lunch without EMU pact accord.

text.p: EU leaders broke for lunch on Friday without agreement on a post-EMU stability pact, but Irish Prime Minister John Bruton was said to be optimistic that a deal could be reached, an EU diplomat said.
"He feels that agrement is very close," the diplomat said.

Irish finance minister Ruairi Quinn had brought together a small group of finance ministers to try to get a deal but another source said later that this group too had broken for lunch, apparently without agreement.
A number of sources suggested that the leaders and their ministers would return to the issue later in the day.

A German delegation source said the finance ministers had be sent off to sort out the pact while the leaders discussed employment issues. "When they (the finance ministers) have a result, they will take it to the leaders," the German source said.
